earlier_failures.cause: legacy compiler received a relative source path; fixed absolute Windows paths
MariaDB client SOURCE command incorrectly followed USE in one command; fixed database selection option
test event year 2099 exceeded native timestamp range; fixed relative disabled event

limitations: SQL database only; external photos/configuration require separate backup
No automatic restore over a merchant's live database
No actual OS shutdown during tests; action ordering tested with substitutes
Verified-TLS configurations require separate CLI setup
